title: First Practical Experiences Integrating Quantum Computers with HPC Resources: A Case Study With a 20-qubit Superconducting Quantum Computer
problem: Integrating quantum computers with traditional HPC systems presents facility, operational, and training challenges
motivation: Quantum computing requires specialized facility management; practical integration roadmap needed for HPC centers
method: Case study of 20-qubit superconducting quantum computer integration at Leibniz Supercomputing Centre
key_novelty: First-hand operational experience with quantum-HPC integration; practical facility and scheduler requirements
contributions: Facility requirements survey for quantum computer deployment in HPC
Automated quantum recalibration within HPC scheduler
